targets.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "metrics", tag: "device_id", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "smart", start: -30d)
  |> count()
  |> yield(name: "count")

panels.title: Devices with SMART issues
panels.description: Devices where any SMART attribute's status code is non-zero (0 = passed) as of its most recent scan.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "smart")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^attr\..*\.status$/)
  |> last()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value != 0)
  |> group(columns: ["device_id"])
  |> distinct(column: "device_id")
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> yield(name: "count")

from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: -1d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "temp" and r._field == "temp")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> max()
  |> yield(name: "max")
